# Vendored reference — smartconnect-linux

Source: https://github.com/rudrahnpatel/smartconnect-linux (MIT, LICENSE
vendored alongside). Docs only — no upstream code is part of ec0.

These protocol notes describe Motorola Smart Connect (`com.motorola.mobiledesktop`,
build 09.0.3.x) wire behavior, worked out by that project for interoperability
against an unmodified phone app. Tags: OBSERVED (verified) vs INFERRED
(hypotheses) are preserved verbatim — treat INFERRED as unconfirmed.

Purpose in ec0: reference material for the T15 intake
(see ../../smart-connect-findings.md and ../../smart-connect-ec0-delta.md)
and future Smart Connect support in ec0-engine. MIT permits reuse with
attribution; ec0 remains GPL-3.0 and keeps its own clean-room rule: describe
behavior in our own words, never transplant upstream code.
